""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions = [] seen_names = set() # 1. Look for dt elements with sig class (Sphinx-style docs) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) signature = block.get_text(strip=True) # Extract return type if present return_type = "unknown" sig_return = block.find(class_="sig-return") if sig_return: return_type = sig_return.get_text(strip=True) # Find description in next dd element dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") description = "" params_info = {} if dd: # Get main description from first paragraph first_p = dd.find("p") if first_p: description = first_p.get_text(strip=True) else: description = dd.get_text(strip=True)[:300] # Extract parameter descriptions from dl/dt/dd structure param_list = dd.find("dl", class_="field-list") if param_list: for param_dt in param_list.find_all("dt"): param_name = param_dt.get_text(strip=True) param_dd = param_dt.find_next_sibling("dd") if param_dd: params_info[param_name] = param_dd.get_text(strip=True)[:150] if not description: description = "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature, params_info), "return_type": return_type, }) # 2. Look for function signatures in headers for tag in ["h3", "h2", "h4"]: headers = soup.find_all(tag) for block in headers: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) # Look for description - try multiple elements description = "" next_p = block.find_next_sibling("p") if next_p: description = next_p.get_text(strip=True) else: next_div = block.find_next_sibling("div") if next_div: description = next_div.get_text(strip=True)[:300] if not description: description = "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text, {}), "return_type": "unknown", }) # 3. Look for code blocks with adjacent descriptions code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for block in code_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 200: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names and name.replace("_", "").isalnum(): seen_names.add(name) # Try to find description in parent or next sibling parent = block.parent description = "" if parent: next_elem = parent.find_next_sibling() if next_elem and next_elem.name in ["p", "div"]: description = next_elem.get_text(strip=True) if not description: description = "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text, {}), "return_type": "unknown", }) return functions[:35] # Return more functions for better completeness def extract_parameters(signature: str, param_descriptions: Dict[str, str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string param_descriptions: Optional dict mapping parameter names to descriptions Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ if param_descriptions is None: param_descriptions = {} params = [] # Extract parameters from signature match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string: param_parts = param_string.split(",") for part in param_parts: part = part.strip() if part and part not in ["self", "cls", "*", "**"]: # Try to extract type hints param_name = part.split("=")[0].split(":")[0].strip() # Remove * or ** prefix param_name = param_name.lstrip("*") param_type = "unknown" default_val = None # Extract type if present if ":" in part: type_part = part.split(":")[1].split("=")[0].strip() param_type = type_part if type_part else "unknown" # Extract default if present if "=" in part: default_val = part.split("=")[1].strip() # Get description from extracted parameter info param_desc = param_descriptions.get(param_name, "") params.append({ "name": param_name, "type": param_type, "default": default_val, "description": param_desc, }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("return_type") and doc["return_type"] != "unknown": output.append(f"Returns: {doc['return_type']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: param_line = f" - {param['name']}" if param.get('type') and param['type'] != 'unknown': param_line += f" ({param['type']})" if param.get('description'): param_line += f": {param['description']}" output.append(param_line) output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
